description: v3.1.0 Point-and-click rule builder. Atom + scene plugins, never session plugins. Session plugin that decides which plugins a scene may load, and redirects plugin references to your own builds without editing scenes or var packages.
instructions: Add as a Session Plugin (User Preferences > Plugins > Session Plugins). Rules live in Saves/PluginData/PluginPass/rules.json and can be edited from the plugin UI.
